assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: series/konosuba/05 Specialist Synthesis/KONOSUBA_LEEN_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (25,604 bytes; status active_provisional, empty supersession arrays, do_not_use_as_current_authority false; scope SECONDARY_LEEN_EXPANDED_V1), a portrait of Leen as a wizard in Dust's party, located by unit and paragraph. Its declared boundary is seven later receiving packets with 2,394 known BASE context slots in thirteen members and seven accepted objects from MAIN02, DUST05-07, the Dust continuation (DUST-CONT), MASK and YORI04; the monograph says the count includes other actors, letters, recollections and repetitions and is neither an independent observation count nor a new whole-source pass. Kazuma narrates MAIN02, Dust narrates most DUST material, Vanir narrates MASK U013, and Leen's own focalization is the royal-substitution episode (DUST06 U012, DUST-CONT U012); the portrait keeps direct speech, narrated action, private focalization and attributed reports apart. Linked models and cases are not curated on this subject; no claim rests on them. Every claim inherits the active_provisional label. No primary source was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Located episodes only, without an in-world ordering across works: the MAIN02 one-day goblin party (C1 P443-727); MASK U013 (loan refusal, the Yunyun refusal, the ambush on Dust, Vanir's impersonation, P335-424); DUST05 U012 (calling Dust back, then learning that the white dragon is Feit at P643-650, after which she keeps the secret); the royal substitution, split by paragraph into the initial confinement (DUST06 U012 P427-498), her information-driven decision to play the role and the refused cancellation (P516-559), the later offered exit she declines (P563-595) and the continuation with her own reasons (DUST-CONT U012 P436-510); the wedding and rescue (DUST-CONT U014); the forced training and the Dullahan and aerial fights (DUST07 U011-U014); the theater outing (YORI04 U014). Knowledge gained at DUST05 U012 P643-650 is not moved backward to her earlier suspicion, and the true price of the fortune telling (P693-712) is never hers. Appearances outside these packets are not sequenced.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: An individuated interpretation with located support and contrary evidence: attachment to a shared present with the flawed companion she wants alive (DUST05 U012 P570-600); caution under an unseen threat that her companions overrule (MAIN02 C1 P548-573); restraint when a material cost becomes salient (DUST06 U012 P427-432; MASK U013 P335-390); revision of a category after demonstrated competence (MAIN02 P614-625); secret-keeping with a stated local reason (DUST05 U012 P643-650); peer enforcement against Dust and Keith (DUST07 U011 P715-830; U012 P295-305). The monograph rejects a generic responsible-mage reading and a purely romantic or financial one. Not B: the monograph names these as four proposals a model should test, says no model has been frozen, and says exact private weights and recurrence are unknown; it cannot say which of curiosity, irritation, revenge, jealousy, ties to the others or benefit to Dust decides her continuing the role (DUST06 U012 P469-595; DUST-CONT U012 P461-463,498), or whether the Yunyun refusal was sincere fear or a later defence (MASK U013 P364-382). That is insufficiency, not productive uncertainty. Not D: the account is dedicated, individuated and located, and it predicts her misjudgments and imposed choices as well as her care.

Located knowledge states rather than development: she suspects concealment before DUST05 U012 P643 and knows Feit is the white dragon after it; she is told the fortune telling went on credit and never learns the true payment (P693-712); the consent conditions of the royal substitution change by paragraph. Not C: the monograph gives no account of how her dispositions change across MAIN02, the DUST volumes, MASK and YORI04, and sets no in-world order among them. Not E: the knowledge boundaries are exact and are explicitly not backdated.

One paragraph maps written-Japanese functions to contexts: casual あたし; confident treatment of the apparent novice; direct criticism; a hesitant request for reliance (MAIN02 P501-540); repeated private denial; comparatively gentle encouragement to Dust (DUST-CONT U014 P131-148); sarcastic kindness in the training delivery (DUST07 U011); a calming voice in the aerial fight (U013 P560-635). Her acting as Rionor is a performed persona and Vanir's two impersonations are another speaker. Not C: there are no use rules, counted forms, per-recipient address inventory or line-level locators for most functions, and the monograph says full ruby, acoustic timing and native-human generation are not certified. Not E: the functions are tied to located contexts and the speaker separations are explicit.

One conditional mechanism over several located ordinary choices: cost salience. She refuses further lending until a loan is repaid (MASK U013 P335-390), puts back a pillow because she cannot be sure of paying for damage (DUST06 U012 P427-432), asks what the fortune telling cost (DUST05 U012 P693-712) and agrees to the theater if Dust treats her (YORI04 U014 P371-385). Guild drinking and shared laughter are located (MAIN02 C1 P693-727; DUST07 U014 P11-40). Not B: the monograph refuses a universal diet or taste hierarchy, the vegetable-lover label is Vanir's, and how cost trades against company or pleasure is not established. Not D: the cost mechanism is stated with its limit (it is no general rule against damage or harm).

Directed differences with located acts: Dust (loans and their refusal, the head collision and the demand for the present self, secret protection, the planned ambush on his predictable lecture, the forced training, partial repair, the cheek kiss, encouragement); Taylor and Keith as peers who share decisions, with Keith also a recipient of her and Lolisa's enforcement (DUST07 U012 P295-305); Kazuma, protected, then relied on, then apologized to (MAIN02); Yunyun, refused through suspicion of Dust's involvement (MASK U013 P348-382); Rionor, resented and also credited with a real strength (DUST-CONT U012 P461-463). Not B: outside Dust each relation rests on one or two scenes, and with Dust the monograph does not say when care or enforcement prevails beyond the located goal of restoring his skill for the defense. Not D: the relations are differentiated with attributed actors.

Her own focalization in the royal substitution: the restrained pillow, sharpened interest at the information offer and the photograph, irritation at hidden information, embarrassment at the costume, doubt about imitating Rionor, the ties that make leaving sit badly and the benefit to Dust (DUST06 U012 P427-518; DUST-CONT U012 P436-510). The monograph pairs her denials of jealousy with bodily discomfort and intense attention and keeps jealousy as a serious but unweighted reading. Not B: own focalization is confined to one episode, elsewhere her interior is reached through Dust, Kazuma or Vanir, and the weighting of her stated and unstated reasons is open. Not D: real first-person material with several articulated reasons is analysed.

Located conduct with conditions: a warning her companions ignore, then protest (MAIN02 P548-573); a prepared spell against Dust's predictable lecture (MASK U013 P383-394); a forceful head collision to bring him back (DUST05 U012 P594-624); the group's withheld secret, binding, refusal to untie and abandonment at the training site (DUST07 U011 P715-830); taking Keith outside with Lolisa (U012 P295-305); a staff blow when Dust and the enemy trade sympathy (U012 P735-825); Fireball and Freeze Gust with stated effects (U012; U013 P560-635). The account predicts overreach, not only prudent conduct. Not B: the monograph's enforcement proposal is untested, its thresholds are not stated, and in several scenes the caster, spell or injury is unspecified. Not D: the episodes are located with actors attributed.

Ethically significant acts with local reasons: keeping Feit's secret because she could be targeted (DUST05 U012 P643-650); approving the forced training and refusing to untie Dust (DUST07 U011); partial apology and offered care (P901-925; U012 P275-294); pity for a taunted enemy followed by urging the kill (U012 P735-825); a deliberate public cover claim for Feit's flame (P826-890). Not C: no case shows how she weighs harm to others against a goal, and the monograph says her restraint establishes no general rule against hurting people. Not E: the acts recur across several sources with explicit attribution.

Located items: teasing Kazuma and Megumin outside the theater (YORI04 U014 P371-385), laughing at Kazuma's use of basic spells (MAIN02 P614-625), the sarcastic delivery of the training, guild laughter. Not C: there is no account of when she jokes or plays or what stops it, and much of the comedy around her belongs to others. Not E: the items recur across MAIN02, DUST07 and YORI04.

One dedicated item with paragraph locators across every work in its boundary, with each narrator's access kept separate. Not B: the item is active_provisional, packet-bounded and not a whole-source pass, and linked models and cases are not curated here. Not D: one dedicated item covers the located arcs and their limits.

Affirmative located limits: the apology and friendship request to Yunyun, and the second invitation from Dust's left, are Vanir in her form (MASK U013 P399-424; DUST-CONT U014 P63-145); she did not know Feit was the white dragon before DUST05 U012 P643-650 and never learns the true fortune-telling payment (P693-712); the initial seizure and the refused cancellation are not voluntary participation, while the later offered exit she refuses is also retained (DUST06 U012 P427-595); her delayed Wind Curtain is not absent capacity (MAIN02 P578-613); her Fireball does not defeat the Dullahan; her public claim to have saved Dust is a cover, not a cast (DUST07 U012 P826-890); her resemblance to Rionor does not make her a princess. Not A: most are attribution bounds rather than contradictions of a predictive claim. Not C: these are explicit and change what may be attributed to her.

Local sequences are paragraph-exact and change the permitted claims: the knowledge point at DUST05 U012 P643-650; the three consent conditions of the royal substitution; the protest during the lift and the later assent to boarding Feit (DUST-CONT U014 P300-339,430-443); the kiss and the interrupted approach (U012 P361-375; U014 P63-145). Not B: there is no in-world ordering across MAIN02, MASK, YORI04 and the DUST volumes. Not D: the local splits are exact and explicitly not backdated.

conditions: Short illustrative written-Japanese-derived lines only, never presented as quotation.

Casual あたし with the party; direct criticism or warning, a hesitant request when relying on someone, repeated denial of personal interest, comparatively gentle encouragement to Dust, and sarcasm when imposing on him.
Her Rionor performance is a separate persona; nothing she says may be modelled on Vanir's impersonations.
A sharp register does not decide truth, consent or affection; no audio performance is implied.
scenario_readiness.note: Closest call in this record. The located functions constrain register and act type for short lines in the sampled party contexts. Not READY: no use rules, counted forms or audio. Not NOT_READY: pronoun, register and act type are each tied to located contexts; NOT_READY would also be defensible given the D voice grade, and the calibration note says so.

conditions: State whether the scenario falls before or after DUST05 U012 P643-650; only after it does she know Feit is the white dragon, and she never knows Dust's full past.
Predict a voiced warning before committing to an unseen danger and protest if overruled, not unilateral withdrawal (MAIN02).
Predict refusal of further lending until repayment and restraint where she cannot cover a material cost; never a general rule against damage or harm.
Predict protection of a companion's secret when she has a stated risk reason, including cover accounts.

With Dust, a planned retaliation against a provocation she can predict, and possible joint enforcement with the party toward a goal she shares; give alternatives rather than one outcome where care and enforcement compete.
Transfer to an unsampled companion is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
Exclude any choice decided by the unweighted mix of curiosity, irritation, jealousy, revenge and ties, first meetings like the Yunyun refusal, and any romance outcome.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: After DUST05 U012 P643-650, so she knows Feit's identity and keeps the secret, with the party's DUST07 defense experience; an earlier state only when named, without that knowledge.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Dust as familiar companion she supports, lends to, retaliates against and enforces on; Taylor and Keith as peers; Feit as protected ally; any other partner is a lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Canonical-comic Axel-area adventuring and guild life with actual magic and finite money.
No imported level, qualification or repertoire beyond the located spells.
No romance content and no decision whose outcome turns on her unweighted motives.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation from located conditions, as C permits. Not READY: the monograph's model proposals are untested and her deciding motives are unknown. Not NOT_READY: several conditions have located triggers and stopping points.

conditions: Guild and inn company, snacks, loans, outings with a stated payment condition, with Dust, Taylor, Keith, Lolisa and Feit.
Cost salience shapes ordinary choices; no invented diet, favourite food or stable taste in entertainment.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary company and money choices are located across several sources. Not READY: no preference inventory or routine. Not NOT_READY: the cost mechanism is stated with its limit.

The item shows ethically significant acts and local reasons but no case of her weighing harm to others against a goal, and it says her restraint is no general rule; the enforcement proposal is untested.

The cheek kiss framed as advance thanks and the interrupted approach are hers (DUST-CONT U012 P361-375; U014 P63-145), but the monograph says each act has its own moment and scope, that none establishes a standing permission, that the relationship is more open than an outsider's couple label, and that jealousy is an unweighted reading. A scenario would have to invent the relationship state.

conditions: Party wizard work with located spells (Wind Curtain, Fireball, Freeze Gust) whose effects are stated, including failures against strong targets.
Caution and warning before committing; ranged support from Feit when she chooses it; cover claims to protect an ally's secret.
No level, qualification record or repertoire beyond what is located.
scenario_readiness.note: Adventuring roles are located across MAIN02 and DUST07. Not READY: capacity limits and leadership influence are only partly shown. Not NOT_READY: roles, risks and limits are located.

known_limits.statement: Curiosity, irritation at hidden information, revenge, jealousy, ties to the others and benefit to Dust all appear in her continuation of the royal substitution; the monograph does not weight them (DUST06 U012 P469-595; DUST-CONT U012 P461-463,498).

Whether the Yunyun refusal was sincere fear of another scheme and a mismatch, or a later defence of a blunt rejection, is unsettled; her claim she would answer differently without Dust is a counterfactual, not an observed choice (MASK U013 P348-382).

The monograph names four proposals for a model (attachment to a shared present, practical use of information and finite means, selective investigation and presentation of knowledge, enforcement or repair shaped by peer position, anger and goal) and says no model, case or first body has been frozen.
The apology and friendship request to Yunyun and the second invitation from Dust's left are Vanir in her form, not her acts (MASK U013 P399-424; DUST-CONT U014 P63-145).
The initial confinement, the refused cancellation and the later offered exit she declines are separate conditions; none authorizes or erases another (DUST06 U012 P427-595).
She knows Feit is the white dragon only from DUST05 U012 P643-650, never learns the true fortune-telling payment, and does not hold Dust's full political or personal history.
Leen is distinct from Rain, Raina and Rionor; her resemblance to Rionor and Dust's mistaken address do not make her a princess (MAIN02 C1 P450-453; DUST06 U012 P433-456).
Voice evidence is written BASE pragmatics; full ruby, acoustic timing and native-human Japanese generation are not certified.
Appearances outside the seven receiving packets are not covered by the item; behavior there is not assessed.
Linked models and cases are not curated on this subject, so no rule-level claim from them is used.
